reconstructed_captions.1: The hands lay the black material flat on a work surface with a white grid.
reconstructed_captions.2: A clear acrylic template is placed on top of the black material.
reconstructed_captions.3: The hands adjust the position of the clear template on the material.
reconstructed_captions.4: One hand holds the template firmly in place on the material.
reconstructed_captions.5: The other hand picks up a white chalk pencil.
reconstructed_captions.6: The hand brings the tip of the chalk pencil to the edge of the template.
reconstructed_captions.7: A close-up view shows the chalk pencil poised to begin tracing.
reconstructed_captions.8: The hand aligns the pencil to start tracing along a straight edge of the template.
reconstructed_captions.9: The chalk pencil begins to trace a straight line along the template's edge.
reconstructed_captions.10: The hand continues drawing the straight white line on the black material.
reconstructed_captions.11: The hand repositions the chalk pencil to trace a different part of the template.
reconstructed_captions.12: The chalk pencil is now positioned at the beginning of a curved edge on the template.
